description: Patches for the official Pixel Camera: open captured media in any installed gallery instead of requiring Google Photos, and keep Add Me working in a re-signed build.

patches.name: Run Add Me without the EdgeTPU
patches.description: Makes Add Me load its CPU models instead of the Tensor EdgeTPU models. Without this, Add Me crashes the app instantly in any renamed or re-signed build, because the EdgeTPU allowlist rejects it and the app aborts instead of falling back. Add Me becomes slower. Disable only if the original package name and signature are preserved.

patches.name: Use third-party gallery
patches.description: Allows the Pixel Camera thumbnail to open captured media in the system-default gallery instead of requiring Google Photos.

patches.name: Use third-party gallery on lock screen
patches.description: Also opens lock screen captures in the system-default gallery. Third-party galleries do not implement Android's secure review contract, so the gallery may show your entire library above the lock screen.
